build_L1Loss_masked: build a masked L1 loss module that computes L1 loss on masked estimate and output tensors
build_L2Loss_masked: build a masked L2 loss module that computes MSE loss on masked estimate and output tensors
build_ClipLoss_contrastive: build a CLIP contrastive loss module that computes cross-entropy scores between estimates and candidates
test_ClipLoss_get_scores: test the ClipLoss get_scores method to compute a matching score matrix between estimates and candidates
build_FeatureDecodingLoss: build a feature decoding loss module that combines MSE regression and cross-entropy classification on word stimulus features
